services.desc: Have you ever dreamt of curating your own exhibition and showcasing a captivating narrative through the lens of talented photographers? Let us help make your creative dream a reality! As a Guest Curator at OPW, you'll have the unique opportunity to curate an exhibition that will run in our Oakland Chinatown gallery for approximately eight weeks. You're in charge of setting the theme or concept, identifying photographic artists whose work resonates with your vision, and hand-picking the final images that best convey your message.
